Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

1. Scope —Covers dimensional and other requirements for Doyen's pattern mouth gag used in resusci- 
tation, oral surgery and anaesthesia.

2.1 A deviation of ± 2*5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

3. Material — Stainless steel bars conforming to Designation 22Cr13 or 30Cr13of IS: 6603-1972 
' Specification for stainless steel bars and flats *. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The gag shall be frae from rough edges, pits, cracks, burrs, seams and other surface defects. 

4.2 All edges shall be smooth and even. 

4.3 The ratchet teeth shall be sharp and well formed. 

4.4 The gag shall be polished bright and passivated. 

5. Heat Treatment - The gag shall be hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 430 to 490 HV. 
8. Tests 

8.1 Flexibility Test — Locl< the two arms of the gag in its fully opened position. Apply a compressive 
force of 400 N at the middle of finger loops. Attain the force gradually and apply for two minutes. On 
completion of the test, the gag shall not show any sign of damage. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance Test — Scrub the gag with soap and warm water, rinse in hot water and then 
dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the gag. Immerse in copper sulphate solution at room temperature 
for 6 minutes and then wash off with fresh water or wet cotton wool. The composition of the solution 
shall be as follows: 

Copper sulphate ( CuSO^.SH^O ) 40 g 

Sulphuric acid ( H,S04 ) ( sp gr 1 84 ) 1 0'O g 

Distilled water [ see IS : 1070-1960 Specification for water, 90-0 ml 
distilled qualit/ ( rtvised ) ] 

There shall be no red stains or spots on the sample but dulling of polished surface may be 
permitted. 

7. IMarking — The gag shall be marked with manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark. 
7.1 Certification Marking — DetaWs available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

8. Packing ~- As agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 



Reprography Unit, BIjB, New Delfil, India
